description: Fetches news articles, court records, and search results from the International Criminal Court (ICC) website at www.icc-cpi.int, bypassing Cloudflare protection.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_news_article: Fetch a single news article; requires url parameter; 参数: limit, url; 必填: url
  - list_news: List recent news articles; optional limit parameter; 参数: limit; 必填: 无
  - search: Search the ICC website; requires query parameter; 参数: limit, query; 必填: query
  - get_document: Fetch a court record/document; requires url parameter; 参数: limit, url; 必填: url
  - get_rss: Fetch RSS feed; optional feed_type (news/records) and limit parameters; 参数: limit, feed_type; 必填: 无

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (used by list_news, search, and get_rss functions)

url.description: URL of the news article or document to fetch (required for get_news_article and get_document functions)

query.description: Search query string (required for search function)

feed_type.description: Type of RSS feed to fetch - 'news' or 'records' (used by get_rss function)
